pkgmetadata.longdescription: tqftpserv is a TFTP server speaking the AF_QIPCRTR protocol, used to serve files between the application processor and the other processors on Qualcomm SoCs. Requests below /readonly/firmware/image/ are translated to the firmware directory of the matching remoteproc and served read-only, transparently decompressing .zst compressed images, while requests below /readwrite/ are served from /var/lib/tqftpserv. It is mainly needed by the modem firmware, which reads its images through it during boot.
